scheme_name: PM POSHAN - Prime Minister's Overarching Scheme For Holistic Nourishment
other_conditions: Applicant must be a citizen of India.
Applicant must be studying in Class 1 to Class 8 (Primary or Upper Primary) in a government or government‑aided school.
Children in pre‑schools or Bal Vatika (before Class I) are also eligible.
benefits_summary: Provides free hot cooked meals meeting defined nutrition and food norms to children studying in government or government‑aided schools up to class 8.
